'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Greg Shaw DS Combat Readiness (V)|list from the day before]], with these changes: - Admiral Piett / + Dengar With Gun (V). The list below applies them.
